title: The Whole Task Force Quit Because Kira Might Know Their Faces . . . (highlight)
caption:
In Death Note episode 3, the entire police task force walks out on the case, afraid Kira knows their faces. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #recap #animerewind

segments.say: The entire task force walks out on the case, because Kira might know their *faces*.
To see how it got here, go back to Jack, plotting with *Ryuk*.
He left fifty criminals alive on purpose, so L would suspect the *police*.
His real goal is to get close to L, and then *eliminate* him.
Ryuk asks how. Jack says nobody in this world truly trusts *anyone*.
Ryuk grins while Jack explains. L will investigate the police, and the police will resent *L*.

segments.text: I can let the police do that for me.

segments.say: Right on cue, a row of detectives stands before the chief and demands a different *case*.

segments.text: Isn't it clear? It's because we value our lives, sir.

segments.say: They say Kira can kill from anywhere, and they refuse to be his next *victims*.
L's last request was the real warning. Every victim's face had been on *television*.
And the police wear IDs with their names and faces on them. Anyone with a computer can find *them*.

segments.text: The truth is we could be killed by killer at any time.
